subject: Integration partnership — hospitality guest data
body: Hi there, I'm the CTO at GuestVault. We provide a guest identity and preferences platform used by about 200 boutique hotels across the US. I noticed Compound Ventures is building in the hospitality space and I think there could be a natural integration between our guest data layer and your AI-powered guest experience tools. We already have APIs for guest profile lookup, stay history, and preference management. Would love to set up a 30-minute call to explore. We're based in Austin but can do this async if easier.
